issues.message: Battery-fallback/absent/supplement/DPPM states are not represented by this single USB-present graph. Do not claim battery runtime or guaranteed battery output.
Protected4.2V one-cell pack, >=330mA charge/discharge capability, polarity and external temperature supervision have not been selected/verified. Charger is not pack protection.
Fixed10k TS bypass intentionally disables battery-temperature monitoring; safety review or external supervision required before promotion.
Actual nominal catalog values are sourced, but tolerance/DC-bias/temperature-dependent effective capacitance and ESR are not independently verified.

Native routing, ground/power loops/EP thermal copper, loaded output voltage/efficiency, switch/inductor transient/current/temperature, USB startup and charger termination remain unverified. Typical curves support assumptions, not hardware guarantees.

Battery arithmetic assumes loaded3.2V minimum through protection cutoff, <=100mV BQdrop at<=1A/VBAT>3V, <=100mV wiring,85% TPS efficiency,25C and separately enforced quiet-audio budget. These are not qualified pack/hardware facts. NTC temperature corners use a beta approximation with TIbias/trip and SEMITECR25/Beta tolerances; not a certified0–50C window or response-time proof.

Unqualified beta-model corner estimates: hottrip46.13..55.89C; coldtrip-1.81..2.90C. Inputs: TI72..78uAbias,270..330mVhot/2.0..2.2Vcold; SEMITEC10kOhmR25+/-1%,3435KB25/85+/-1%. Actual R/Tcurve,thermal coupling,response and pack-safe window still require qualification.

Adding a hypothetical5V LED boost at80% efficiency to rail+quietaudio draws1091.74mA, beyond the1A condition used for the guaranteed100mV BQbattery drop. Existing5V audio+LED variants are unpowered withoutUSB. A full-function battery claim needs separately reviewed loads,source/path and/or enforceable transient/current limits.
